# JoOutLoud

> JoOutLoud provides restorative practice support, youth conflict resolution, and digital literacy programs led by Jo Phillips, a resilience coach and speaker specializing in high-stakes situations and team culture.

JoOutLoud serves schools, organizations, and families across Alberta and beyond with evidence-based programs in conflict resolution, social media safety, AI literacy, and youth engagement. The platform combines restorative justice principles with practical coaching and community-focused interventions.

## Key Topics

- Restorative practices
- Youth conflict resolution
- Social media safety
- AI literacy
- Digital literacy
- BENCHTALK (sports program)
- Restorative leadership
- High-stakes situations
- Team culture
- Behavior management
- School programs
- Parent education
- Systems thinking
- Youth engagement
- Organizational consulting

## Core Programs & Services

- [Programs](https://www.jooutloud.com/programs): JoOutLoud programs: communication, resilience, and conflict resolution for youth
- [BENCHTALK](https://www.jooutloud.com/benchtalk): Youth sports program building accountability and team culture
- [Starting a Social Media Conversation](https://www.jooutloud.com/social-media-safety): Social media safety program for schools with digital communication tools
- [Starting an AI Conversation](https://www.jooutloud.com/starting-an-ai-conversation): AI literacy program for schools: full-community approach to safe AI use
